clauses.text: Before receiving a ballot at a polling place, a voter shall present a current government-issued photo identification.
A voter without identification may cast a provisional ballot, which is counted if the voter presents identification to the county clerk within six days after the election.

current_law: A voter at a polling place states their name and address and signs the poll book. The state issues identification cards free of charge to any registered voter who requests one.
